title: Day 37: Rescheduling & Availability
titleFa: روز ۳۷: تغییر برنامه و موجود بودن

sentences.audioText: Unser Termin morgen — können wir ihn verschieben?
sentences.translation: Our appointment tomorrow — can we reschedule it?

sentences.targetText: Ja, kein Problem. Wann passt es dir besser?
sentences.translation: Yes, no problem. When suits you better?
sentences.translationFa: آره، مشکلی نیست. کی برات بهتره؟

sentences.audioText: Ich hätte Mittwoch oder Donnerstag Zeit.
sentences.translation: I would have time on Wednesday or Thursday.

sentences.targetText: Mittwoch passt mir leider nicht. Donnerstag wäre perfekt.
sentences.translation: Wednesday doesn't work for me unfortunately. Thursday would be perfect.

sentences.targetText: Nachmittags, um vierzehn Uhr, wenn das geht.
sentences.translation: Afternoon, at two o'clock, if that works.
sentences.translationFa: بعدازظهر، ساعت دو، اگه جور باشه.

sentences.audioText: Perfekt. Ich bestätige den Termin per E-Mail.
sentences.translation: Perfect. I'll confirm the appointment by email.
sentences.translationFa: عالی. از طریق ایمیل تأیید می‌کنم.

sentences.audioText: Kannst du auch eine Kalendereinladung schicken?
sentences.translation: Can you also send a calendar invitation?

sentences.targetText: Ja, natuerlich. Welche E-Mail-Adresse soll ich nutzen?
sentences.translation: Yes, of course. Which email address should I use?
sentences.translationFa: بله، البته. از چه آدرس ایمیلی استفاده کنم؟

sentences.audioText: Schick es an meine Bueroadresse: anna.mueller@firma.de
sentences.translation: Send it to my office address: anna.mueller@firma.de

sentences.targetText: Erledigt. Du bekommst die Einladung in wenigen Minuten.
sentences.translation: Done. You will get the invitation in a few minutes.
sentences.translationFa: انجام شد. چند دقیقه دیگه دعوت‌نامه می‌رسه.

sentences.audioText: Perfekt, danke! Wo findet das Treffen eigentlich statt?
sentences.translation: Perfect, thanks! Where is the meeting actually taking place?

sentences.targetText: Im Konferenzraum zwei im ersten Stock.
sentences.translation: In conference room two on the first floor.
sentences.translationFa: در اتاق کنفرانس دو در طبقه اول.

description: Something has come up and you need to reschedule a work meeting. Handle it professionally.
descriptionFa: یه اتفاقی افتاده و باید یه جلسه کاری رو جابجا کنید. حرفه‌ای باهاش کنار بیاید.
